teachingQuestion: How do software-security signals become a risk decision?
focalInsight: No single scanner proves security; converging design, code, test, runtime, and incident evidence supports a better decision.
title: Software security evidence streams
caption: Combine pre-release and runtime evidence, then prioritize, remediate, and retest.
altSummary: Design, code, test, and runtime streams converge on a risk decision, which drives remediation, retest, and improved future design.
textFallback: Threat and design evidence state what should be protected. Code and dependency evidence show what was built. Testing observes selected behavior. Runtime logs, vulnerabilities, and incidents show operational reality. These streams inform a risk decision and priority. Owners remediate and retest, then feed lessons back into design and standards.
